messages:
elena: Planning a two-phase deploy tonight during the 23:45-00:45 UTC DB window: add partial index events(type) WHERE processed = true + run a throttled backfill for older rows. Staging showed p99 dropping from ~3s -> ~180ms for main read. Tagging @ben @tara for pin/flag/rollback plan.

deploy-bot: @elena claimed window 23:45-00:45 UTC for migration 'events-partial-add-backfill' (id: mig-2026-05-10-02). Post final go/no-go at T-15.

ben: Quick Q: is the backfill heavy? If so we should run it as a separate batch job after index create to avoid holding the index build. What's size estimate?

elena: Backfill ~120M rows but only ~18% qualify for processed = true historically. Plan: 1) CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (no lock) 2) verify index 3) launch backfill in small transactions with a 1000-row batch + sleep throttle. That keeps write latencies stable.

tara: We'll pin app to v2.18.0 for the window. Also will gate usage behind feature flag `ff_events_partial_idx` so code won't prefer it until we flip.

dba-bot: Preflight checks: replica_lag < 5s ✅, long_tx_count < 2 ✅, free_disk_pct > 20% ✅, pg_stat_progress_create_index not running ✅. Will monitor during run.

elena: SQL snippets below for ops runbook (use with care):

```sql
-- create index (non-blocking)
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS events_processed_type_idx
ON public.events (type)
WHERE processed = true;

-- backfill approach (example pseudocode shown for batch job)
-- update in batches to set processed = true (if appropriate) OR ensure rows qualify for index
```

```bash
# backfill example (psql + loop)
while true; do
  psql -c "WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM events WHERE processed = true LIMIT 1000) UPDATE events SET processed = true FROM c WHERE events.id = c.id RETURNING 1;"
  sleep 0.5
  # break condition based on rows affected
done
```

ben: For rollback we should be able to: 1) stop backfill job 2) set flag OFF 3) revert app to v2.18.0 4) DROP INDEX IF NEEDED. But dropping large index can be slow; prefer keep and block usage by flag.

tara: Agree. Also we'll add a query tag and telemetry metric to track index usage so we can quickly detect if planner picks it up unexpectedly.

dba-bot: Abort pattern: if index build stalls >20min with <1% progress AND replica lag > 10s, page oncall and cancel build. Cancel snippet: `SELECT pid FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY%' AND state='active';` then `SELECT pg_cancel_backend(<pid>);`. If left broken, `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS events_processed_type_idx;` after safe window.

oncall: I'll be on-call during the window and will watch pages. Set paging thresholds now.

elena: Preflight checklist (T-20):
- app pinned to v2.18.0 (tara)
- feature flag OFF (tara)
- telemetry tag ready (ben)
- disk and replica checks (dba-bot)
- backfill job prepared with resume/cancel hooks (elena/infra)

tara: Pinning done at 23:30 UTC. Verified traffic to pinned instances.

ben: Telemetry tag (`idx=events_processed_type_idx`) added to DB client traces.

dba-bot: All infra checks passed at 23:38 UTC.

deploy-bot: Starting migration job mig-2026-05-10-02 at 23:45:05 UTC. Logs: /deploys/mig-2026-05-10-02/logs

elena: Running CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY now. Monitoring pg_stat_progress_create_index, lock_waits, and write p99.

dba-bot: Index progress: 12% at 23:47. I/O spike moderate. Replica lag 1-3s.

ben: Write p99 holding steady, error budget fine.

oncall: No pages yet. Watching.

elena: Index build at 100% validated at 23:56 UTC. Doing a quick sample explain on top queries.

ben: With flag OFF planner not using index. Good. Moving to canary app release: toggle v2.18.1 to 10% for canary.

tara: Canary rollout started 23:58. Observing canary for 3 minutes.

ben: Canary shows expected perf improvement for targeted endpoints when flag ON. No error spike.

elena: Starting backfill job in throttled mode at 00:05 UTC. Job will run with small tx (500 rows) and sleep 0.6s between batches. Will run until complete; we can abort anytime.

ben: Monitoring queries using telemetry tag. Backfill causing a small p99 write increase (+10%) but within SLO.

dba-bot: Replica lag up to 7s during peak of backfill but under emergency threshold.

oncall: If replication lag crosses 15s, page me.

elena: Backfill paused at 00:18 for quick check. No regressions. Resuming. Estimated remaining ~6h at current throttle; we'll convert to background maintenance job that tolerates low throughput and continues off-window.

tara: Since backfill long, we'll keep index in place and leave feature flag OFF for 6 hours, then enable gradually during low-traffic window tomorrow. That avoids emergency rollback and avoids dropping index.

ben: Rolling app to v2.18.1 full at 00:22 since canary looked good. We'll keep flag OFF as agreed.

elena: Final notes and rollback summary:
- index created with CONCURRENTLY (no blocking locks)
- backfill run throttled; switched to long-running maintenance to finish off-peak
- rollback if needed: stop backfill, set feature flag OFF, revert app to pinned tag; dropping index is last resort and may be slow.

dba-bot: Migration job mig-2026-05-10-02 COMPLETE for index creation at 00:25:30 UTC. Backfill job persisted as maintenance.

oncall: Closing window claim. Keep an eye on telemetry; page if anything odd.

elena: Thanks all. Will file a short release note: "Added partial index events_processed_type_idx; index created, throttled backfill running as maintenance; feature-flag gated rollout." :party_popper:
